B.S. Business Administration

Take charge of your future with a Bachelor of Business Administration degree that’s designed to help you develop the specialized skills you need to land advanced roles in the industry. With concentrations in Finance, Healthcare Management, Logistics, Management, and Marketing, you can shape your education to match your career goals. Plus, you’ll get 24/7 access to a library of faculty-led video resources, so you’ll always have support as you prepare for your next big career move.

Curriculum

Overview

The Bachelor of Science in Business Administration provides a solid foundation in the basics of business with a specific focus on one of the following areas:

  • Finance: Focuses on banking, investments, insurance, and portfolio management, preparing students for advanced roles in the finance industry.

  • Healthcare Management: Prepares students for business roles in healthcare, covering healthcare administration, legal and compliance issues, financial principles, and a senior seminar.

  • Logistics and Supply Chain Management: Focuses on logistical operations, with a comprehensive understanding of business topics like accounting, economics, and negotiation, plus supply chain areas like manufacturing, transportation, and inventory control.

  • Management: Focuses on management training, covering business fundamentals such as accounting, ethics, conflict management, and marketing.

  • Marketing: Specializes in marketing techniques, along with a broad understanding of business operations like accounting, financial management, and marketing principles.
